description: An iterator from a position that's below its collection's size and that its tree doesn't have, which only a clone with a header that disagrees with its tree has: a read at that position raises InvalidBTreeNode. The port's iterator raises InvalidBTreeNode there, from its starting descent, whatever the layout.

ops.note: a clone whose header says 41 over a tree of 31
a read at 31 runs out of tree, in both
the port's starting descent raises what the read at 31 does
a clone whose root counts 8 for a leaf that holds 6
and a read at 14 runs out of its leaf, in both
